rows.title: Sch.2 para 4 — Services relating to vessels and aircraft.
Sch.2 para 5 — Certain transactions treated as exports.
rows.reason: Zero-rating turns on who the customer is (EU institutions, international bodies, foreign armed forces, the Central Bank), not on what was supplied; the invoice line does not carry that. Such a line matches only the standard-rate fallback and is flagged undetermined.

rows.title: Sch.2 para 6 — Services by intermediaries.
rows.reason: Zero-rating turns on what an intermediary obtained for its principal (an export, a listed service, a supply outside the Community), which the invoice line does not carry. Such a line matches only the standard-rate fallback and is flagged undetermined.
